keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Eric Kitolano (Lillestrøm).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lillestrøm 0, Viktoria Plzen 1. Prince Adu (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Patrik Hrosovsky with a through ball.
Delay in match (Lillestrøm).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Cheick Souaré replaces Alexandr Sojka because of an injury.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Stefan Pirgic replaces Patrik Hrosovsky.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Christophe Kabongo replaces Prince Adu.
Substitution, Lillestrøm. Thomas Lehne Olsen replaces Fredrik Gulbrandsen.
Substitution, Lillestrøm. Gustav Nordh replaces Ylldren Ibrahimaj.
Filip Prebsl (Viktoria Plzen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Tomás Ladra replaces Amar Memic.
Substitution, Viktoria Plzen. Denis Vavro replaces Tobiás Paliscák.
Substitution, Lillestrøm. Frederik Elkær replaces Yaw Paintsil.

Gustav Nyheim (Lillestrøm) is shown the yellow card.
Florian Wiegele (Viktoria Plzen) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Lillestrøm 0, Viktoria Plzen 1.
